key_insight: Live visual access to handwritten mathematics shifted AI tutoring toward checking ongoing work, while proactive assistance increased error identification and directive hints.
engineering_relevance: Camera-enabled tutoring systems can ground feedback in handwritten reasoning, making intervention timing and feedback targeting important design choices.
method: Built a multimodal tutoring platform with a live phone-camera view of paper-based work.
Randomized 117 adults solving calculus problems to Text-Reactive, Visual-Reactive, or Visual-Proactive assistance.
Analyzed tutor messages and learner feedback across conditions.
evidence_signal: The study analyzed 2,140 tutor messages; released resources include 255,984 timestamped handwriting images linked to conversations, intervention decisions, and learning outcomes.
watch_item: The abstract reports feedback patterns and learner perceptions, but does not establish improved learning outcomes or generalization beyond adults solving calculus problems.
paper_title: Exploring Visual Access and Proactive AI Tutoring for Handwritten Mathematics
